description: This file defines the LoginWorker class, which manages user login, logout, impersonation, session management, and related security functions within the Apache OFBiz web application framework. It contains methods for login, logout, session cookies, impersonation, and handling login-related events.

classes.name: LoginWorker
classes.description: Final class providing static utility methods for login, logout, impersonation, and session management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeLoginUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for the login page, optionally including current view and request parameters.

methods.name: setLoggedOut
methods.description: Marks a user login record as logged out, updating the UserLogin entity.

methods.name: checkLogout
methods.description: Checks if a user is logged out or flagged for logout, performs logout if necessary.

methods.name: checkImpersonationInProcess
methods.description: Determines if the current user session is involved in an impersonation process.

methods.name: extensionCheckLogin
methods.description: Calls extension services implementing LoginCheck to perform additional login validation.

methods.name: extensionConnectLogin
methods.description: Calls extension services implementing LoginCheck for login pre-processing.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Verifies if a user is logged in; initiates login process if not.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with username, password, or token, manages sessions, cookies, and security context.

methods.name: impersonateLogin
methods.description: Allows an admin to impersonate another user without a password.

methods.name: depersonateLogin
methods.description: Ends impersonation, restoring previous user session.

methods.name: doMainLogin
methods.description: Central method to set user session objects post successful login.

methods.name: doBasicLogin
methods.description: Initial session setup during login, including user preferences and security context.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out a user, invalidates session, and clears security context.

methods.name: doBasicLogout
methods.description: Performs session invalidation and cleanup during logout.

methods.name: autoLoginSet
methods.description: Sets an auto-login cookie and creates a secure JWT cookie if applicable.

methods.name: createSecuredLoginIdCookie
methods.description: Creates a secure cookie with user login ID.

methods.name: createSecuredLoginJwtCookie
methods.description: Creates a JWT-containing cookie for cross-application login.

methods.name: getAutoLoginCookieName
methods.description: Returns the cookie name for auto login based on application context.

methods.name: getSecuredLoginIdCookieName
methods.description: Returns the cookie name for secured login ID.

methods.name: getAutoUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves the auto login ID from cookies.

methods.name: getSecuredUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves the secured login ID from cookies.

methods.name: getSecuredUserLoginByJWT
methods.description: Decodes JWT from cookies and authenticates user login.

methods.name: autoLoginCheck
methods.description: Performs auto login verification based on cookies and session.

methods.name: securedUserLoginByJWTCookie
methods.description: Performs login using JWT cookie for secure cross-app login.

methods.name: autoLoginRemove
methods.description: Removes auto login cookies and related session attributes.

methods.name: isUserLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if the current session has an active logged-in user.

methods.name: loginUserWithUserLoginId
methods.description: Logs in a user solely based on userLoginId.
